import re, serial, time
p='/dev/cu.usbserial-1130'
h=serial.Serial(p,115200,timeout=0.1,write_timeout=1)
h.dtr=False; h.rts=False
time.sleep(0.8)
h.reset_input_buffer()

def collect_window(seconds=5.0):
    buf=bytearray(); end=time.monotonic()+seconds
    while time.monotonic()<end:
        n=h.in_waiting
        if n:
            buf.extend(h.read(n))
        time.sleep(0.02)
    return buf.decode(errors='replace')

def snapshot(index):
    h.reset_input_buffer()
    h.write(b'\nstatus\n'); h.flush()
    text=collect_window(5.0)
    lines=[x.strip() for x in text.replace('\r','').split('\n') if x.strip()]
    status_idx=[i for i,x in enumerate(lines) if x.startswith('status ')]
    if not status_idx:
        raise SystemExit(f'snapshot {index}: missing status line; tail='+repr(text[-2500:]))
    start=status_idx[-1]
    tail=lines[start:]
    status=tail[0]
    timing=next((x for x in tail[1:] if x.startswith('timing ')), None)
    tasks=[x for x in tail[1:] if x.startswith('task ') and ' severity=' in x]
    if timing is None:
        raise SystemExit(f'snapshot {index}: missing timing line; tail='+repr(text[-2500:]))
    if not tasks:
        raise SystemExit(f'snapshot {index}: no complete task lines; tail='+repr(text[-2500:]))
    return status,timing,tasks

def field(line,key):
    m=re.search(r'(?:^| )'+re.escape(key)+r'=([^ ]+)', line)
    if not m:
        raise SystemExit('missing '+key+' in '+line)
    return m.group(1)

shots=[]
for i in range(1,4):
    shots.append(snapshot(i))
    time.sleep(0.5)
h.close()
boot_ids=[]
reset_reasons=[]
for idx,(status,timing,tasks) in enumerate(shots,1):
    if field(status,'firmware_sha')!='3058625be2f35c121afcf82549d5c73068839ecd':
        raise SystemExit('wrong firmware: '+status)
    if field(status,'outputs')!='fake-locked':
        raise SystemExit('outputs not fake-locked: '+status)
    if int(field(status,'internal_free')) <= 0 or int(field(status,'internal_min')) <= 0 or int(field(status,'internal_largest')) <= 0:
        raise SystemExit('invalid internal heap metrics: '+status)
    if int(field(status,'psram_free')) <= 0 or int(field(status,'psram_min')) <= 0 or int(field(status,'psram_largest')) <= 0:
        raise SystemExit('invalid psram metrics: '+status)
    boot_ids.append(field(status,'boot_id'))
    reset_reasons.append(field(status,'reset_reason'))
    if int(field(timing,'loop_overruns')) != 0:
        raise SystemExit('loop overrun observed: '+timing)
    known=[]
    for line in tasks:
        configured=int(field(line,'configured_stack_bytes'))
        hwm=int(field(line,'hwm_bytes'))
        severity=field(line,'severity')
        if configured > 0:
            known.append((hwm/configured,line))
            if hwm*100 < configured*25 or severity in ('warning','critical'):
                raise SystemExit('known task stack below 25 percent: '+line)
    store=[x for x in tasks if 'name=stage27_store ' in x]
    if len(store)!=1:
        raise SystemExit('missing complete stage27_store line')
    known.sort(key=lambda x:x[0])
    print(f'SNAPSHOT_{idx}_STATUS',status)
    print(f'SNAPSHOT_{idx}_TIMING',timing)
    print(f'SNAPSHOT_{idx}_STAGE27_STORE',store[0])
    if known:
        print(f'SNAPSHOT_{idx}_LOWEST_KNOWN_STACK',known[0][1])
if len(set(boot_ids)) != 1:
    raise SystemExit('boot id changed across snapshots: '+repr(boot_ids))
if len(set(reset_reasons)) != 1:
    raise SystemExit('reset reason changed across snapshots: '+repr(reset_reasons))
print('STAGE28E_A_HW_BOOT_ID_STABLE',boot_ids[0])
print('STAGE28E_A_HW_RESET_REASON_STABLE',reset_reasons[0])
print('STAGE28E_A_HW_CONFIRM_V2_PASS')
